name: Honey
description: Honey is a sweet, viscous liquid produced by honey bees. It is rich in antioxidants and has antimicrobial properties.
benefits_hair: Enhances shine and manageability of hair
best_for: People with scars or hyperpigmentation on the face
avoid_for: Individuals allergic to bees or honey
Those with severe acne or broken skin
how_to_use: Mix honey with a carrier oil and apply to clean, damp skin for a mask.
Apply raw honey directly to the scalp for 10-20 minutes before washing off.
Use as a leave-in treatment on hair by applying to damp hair, comb through and style as usual.
possible_side_effects: May cause an allergic reaction in sensitive individuals
Can attract bacteria if not properly stored
scientific_evidence: Studies have shown honey's antibacterial properties and its effectiveness in treating various skin conditions. Research also supports the use of honey as a natural hair conditioner.
